name: phytmo
paper_title: A database of physical therapy exercises with variability of execution collected by wearable sensors
authors: Sara Garcia-de-Villa, Ana Jimenez-Martin, Juan Jesus Garcia-Dominguez
license: Dataset: CC-BY (Zenodo 6319979). Paper: CC-BY (Scientific Data, open access).
notes: 30 volunteers aged 20-69 in five 10-year age groups (A 20-29, B 30-39, C 40-49, D 50-59, E 60-69) performed 6 exercises and 3 gait variations, each in two correct and two deliberately incorrect series of at least 8 repetitions, with 4 magneto-inertial units plus optical motion capture. FILENAME CONVENTION taken from the paper, not guessed: GNNEEELP_S, where P = 0 correctly performed / 1 wrongly performed and S = series 1 or 2; *Calib files are calibration motions and are skipped. Exercise codes (paper): EFE elbow flex-extension, EAH extension of arms over head, SQZ squeezing, KFE knee flex-extension, SQT squat, HAA hip abduction, GAT natural gait, GIS infinity-symbol gait, GHT heel-tiptoe gait. GIS and GHT carry no 0/1 digit — they ARE the gait variations. Placements: shins + thighs (anterior surface) for lower-limb trials, arms + forearms (exterior lateral) for upper-limb. 100 Hz inertial (magnetometer 20 Hz, dropped). Units from the CSV header: accelerometer in g, gyroscope in DEG/S -> converted to rad/s. VERIFIED AT CONVERT TIME: median |acc| 1.008 g, |gyro| p99.9 max 883 deg/s, clock 100.89 Hz. 8 of 4,520 CSVs contain all-NaN dropped-packet rows, all from subject C02 on one exercise; isolated single-sample holes are interpolated and 4 trials whose left-shin unit is 40% missing are SKIPPED rather than interpolated. The correct/incorrect flag is carried into the label.
